compat_entries_673: Riftborne: utility and gravity-device fabrication uses Arcane controls.
Spatial Lenses, Haulers, Tether Winches, Pulse Drives, Phase Stickers and Stasis Cores.
Riftborne: Rift Hearts, ship-jump hardware, Slipgates and field projectors use Eclipse controls.
Rift Hearts use Mechanical Crafters. Native fluids, fuel costs and jump mechanics remain.
Riftborne: used to fabricate the A.P.E.X. Tap. This is a construction cost, not a cost per generated resource.
Riftborne: the machine body for the A.P.E.X. Base and A.P.E.X. Nexus.
Native anomaly capture, Shulker Burners, levels and operating costs still apply.
Eclipse-tier component assembled with Mechanical Crafters.
Retains the native Noctite, Eye of Ender, Netherite, Phase Catalysts and Spatial Lens, plus one Eclipse Mechanism.
progression_table_1571: Crafted with a Creation Machine component in Mechanical Crafters.
Place beneath the lava source in a Create chute generator. Keep the chute beneath the generated ore.
Produces Iron, Copper, Zinc, Gold, Redstone, Lapis, Diamond, Emerald or Quartz Ore.
The ore depends on generator position, so Create drills and their predictions agree.
progression_table_1577: The most expensive production recipe: repeat the assembly sequence 64 times.
Consumes 320 Creation Machine components and 64 each of Creative Blaze Cakes, Creative Bookshelves,
Creation Ore Catalysts, Netherite Blocks, Nether Stars and Eclipse Mechanisms.
